node.title: E1 actual folded-certificate manifest payload
node.statement: Construct the named folded-certificate manifest for the E1 open cells N' in {128,256}. This is now conditional on the proved two-cell assembly rule plus the actual N'=128 and N'=256 folded-certificate cell payloads, each with a named exhibit field, complete folded kernel certificate, and zero nonzero non-cyclotomic folded vectors.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the two explicit E1 folded-certificate cell payloads
node.falsifier: missing N'=128 or N'=256 cell payload, an incomplete folded certificate, or a nonzero folded vector in either listed certificate
